name: hud_line_clip_clip_segment_to_current_bounds
description: HudLineClip::ClipSegmentToCurrentBounds clips a 2D segment against the current X bounds first, then the current Y bounds if the segment remains visible.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly and decompilation at 0x4bd840 have no warnings or tags and call HudLineClip::ClipSegmentToCurrentXBounds first, returning 0 immediately on rejection, otherwise tailing into HudLineClip::ClipSegmentToCurrentYBounds.
The native line-clip smoke verifies a segment crossing both X bounds remains visible and is clipped to the current rectangle with both endpoint flags set.
vc5_attempt: python tools/recoil.py verify vc5 --explain-missing 0x4bd840 reported no VC verification target currently covers this address.
